blocks.x: Applied AI & GenAI inside Public Sector & Government: the operating realities we design for, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Public Sector & Government, applied ai & generative ai at dataq soft covers the full lifecycle of enterprise intelligence: strategy and value mapping, platform build-out, model adaptation, retrieval architectures, multimodal systems, and the governance fabric that keeps every model auditable. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: enterprise ai strategy & roadmapping, generative ai platform engineering, llm fine-tuning & model operations — delivered on Dataq Compass and Dataq Forge and Dataq Nexus with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Permits, claims and case files are paper-shaped; processing times measured in months erode trust and increase cost per case.
Benefits, tax, health and licensing systems never joined; citizens re-submit the same facts to every agency. Fraud and error hide in the seams.
Aging systems with hardening debt meet rising state-grade threats; accreditation cycles slow every change.

blocks.x: How we deliver it in this sector

Delivery composes 7 services from the Applied AI & Generative AI tower — Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping, Generative AI Platform Engineering, LLM Fine-Tuning & Model Operations, RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems as the usual core — sequenced through the Dataq Method, with GDPR / national privacy law obligations shaping the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products: retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
Answers with citations, not vibes: permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.
Grounded answers on entitlements and procedures across web and voice with citations (first-contact resolution up sharply)
Permits/claims classified, extracted and summarized for officers (processing time down 40-60%)
First-contact resolution up sharply with grounded assistants

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: GDPR / national privacy law and Records/archives law. Retention, integrity and evidence requirements. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
